player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN pp.home_team_goal > pp.away_team_goal THEN 'WIN'
            WHEN pp.away_team_goal > pp.home_team_goal THEN 'LOSS'
            ELSE NULL
        END as match_result
    FROM player_participations pp
    JOIN Player p ON pp.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
),
player_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_result = 'WIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_result = 'LOSS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as loss_count
    FROM player_matches
    WHERE match_result IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_name
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT player_name FROM player_counts ORDER BY win_count DESC LIMIT 1) as player_with_most_wins,
    (SELECT win_count FROM player_counts ORDER BY win_count DESC LIMIT 1) as max_wins,
    (SELECT player_name FROM player_counts ORDER BY loss_count DESC LIMIT 1) as player_with_most_losses,
    (SELECT loss_count FROM player_counts ORDER BY loss_count DESC LIMIT 1) as max_losses
